question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Bait
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bait"** means something that is used to attract or tempt someone; it could be a lure. (चारा)

 
 
• **Example: **He used worms as** bait **to catch fish.
 
 
 
• **"Allurement"** refers to the power of attracting or tempting someone. (प्रलोभन)
 
 
• **Example: **The **allurement** of the big city was hard to resist for the young artist.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'bait'** is **'allurement'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Greed** (लालच): Intense and selfish desire for something, especially wealth, power, or food.

 
 
• **Example:** His greed for money led him down a dark path.
 
 
 
• **Food** (खाना): Any nutritious substance that people or animals eat or drink to maintain life and growth.
 
 
• **Example: **She loves Italian food.
 
 
 
• **Repulsion** (घृणा): A feeling of intense distaste or disgust.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt a strong repulsion towards the cruel practice.
